name: Disco Carrot
description: Mobile DJ stage and art installation built on a 1973 Thiokol Spryte snowcat. Concert-quality sound, club-style lighting, and full-production entertainment for ski resorts, festivals, and outdoor events across western North America.
shortDescription: Mobile DJ stage and art installation built on a 1973 Thiokol Spryte snowcat. Based in Missoula, Montana.
